'''2011 Bespin Regionals Jim Li DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
